constraints.source_text: Candidates for the Bachelor of Arts in Art History must complete the general education and diversity requirements of the USC Dornsife College of Letters, Arts and Sciences.
constraints.description: Students must complete Dornsife's general education and diversity requirements, which are not enumerated here.
constraints.note: No course list given for GE/diversity requirements in this text.

constraints.source_text: AHIS 120gp Foundations of Western Art: Prehistoric to Renaissance Units: 4 or AHIS 121gp Foundations of Western Art: Renaissance to Contemporary Units: 4
constraints.description: Student must take one of AHIS 120 or AHIS 121.

constraints.source_text: Choose one course from: AHIS 125gp Arts of Asia I: Antiquity to 1300 Units: 4, AHIS 126g Arts of Asia II: 1300 to the Present Units: 4, AHIS 127g Arts of the Ancient Americas Units: 4, AHIS 128gp The Arts and Society in Latin America, Colonial to Contemporary Units: 4
constraints.description: Student must choose one course from the given list of four courses.

constraints.source_text: AHIS 494 Undergraduate Proseminar in Art History Units: 4 is required
constraints.description: AHIS 494 is a required fixed course.

constraints.source_text: Seven additional ​courses to include five courses with a minimum of one in each of four out of the following five areas of study, only one of which may be at the 200 level.
constraints.description: Student must select seven additional courses from the five listed areas of study.

details.pool_rule: Greek and Roman art and archaeology; Medieval art; Renaissance and Baroque art; Modern and contemporary art; Non-European traditions

constraints.source_text: Seven additional ​courses to include five courses with a minimum of one in each of four out of the following five areas of study, only one of which may be at the 200 level.
constraints.description: Of the seven additional courses, five must include at least one from each of four of the five areas of study.

details.scope: chosen from the five areas of study, out of the seven additional courses

constraints.note: The '4 out of 5 areas' phrasing is treated as a category bound over the five-course subset.

constraints.source_text: only one of which may be at the 200 level.
constraints.description: At most one of the five distribution courses may be at the 200 level.

details.scope: five distribution courses across the four required areas

constraints.source_text: and two that must be at the 400-level
constraints.description: At least two of the seven additional courses must be at the 400 level.
constraints.note: Placement relative to the numbered list suggests this applies to the seven additional courses overall.

constraints.source_text: AHIS 400x Undergraduate Apprenticeship Units: 2 counts for elective credit only and may not be applied to the major.
constraints.description: AHIS 400x cannot be counted toward the major, only toward electives.

details.effect: counts for elective credit only, not toward major

constraints.source_text: The following courses require the written permission of a faculty adviser and the Director of Undergraduate Studies. Directed Research is limited to fulfilling 4 units of a student’s major requirements. AHIS 490x Directed Research Units: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, AHIS 495a Undergraduate Honors Thesis Units: 2, AHIS 495b Undergraduate Honors Thesis Units: 2
constraints.description: AHIS 490x, 495a, and 495b require written permission from a faculty adviser and the Director of Undergraduate Studies.

details.approver: faculty adviser and Director of Undergraduate Studies

constraints.source_text: Directed Research is limited to fulfilling 4 units of a student’s major requirements.
constraints.description: No more than 4 units of AHIS 490x Directed Research may count toward the major.
constraints.note: Classified as a distribution bound on units from a single course source; could also be seen as Course Reuse.

unclassified.source_text: The Bachelor of Arts in Art History requires 128 units.
unclassified.why: This is a total-degree-unit statement with no pool or filter to attach it to; the taxonomy's families all require a filter/measure/bound on a subset of courses, not the whole degree total.

unclassified.source_text: AHIS 494 Undergraduate Proseminar in Art History Units: 4 (the capstone course) may be taken in either the junior or senior year.
unclassified.why: This states flexible timing rather than a strict prerequisite ordering, milestone, or unit window, so it does not cleanly fit the Sequencing family's defined kinds; also reads as informational/advisory.
